title: Ghazi paasa
body:
Ghazi paasa
Zainab waey jel khanayna raghla
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Khud raghla jel khanayna Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ye dekhe mere in shaano par hai neel rasan ke ghazi) x2 Faryad kare ye behna, haye faryaad kare ye behna, Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2 Khud raghla jel khanayna Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar (ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Mei teri sakina ko ghazi, zindaa mei chor ke ayi hu) x2 Zakhmi hai ghamo se sina, Haye zakhmi hai ghamo se sina, Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2 Khud raghla jel khanayna Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar (ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Tu hota aghar mere ghazi chinti na haram ki chadar) x2 Bechadar hogayi behna, haaye bechadar hogayi behna
Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2 Khud raghla jel khanayna Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar (ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Kya haal huwa bazaaro mei, bhayi ne sina se dekha) x2 baalo se chupayya chehra, haaye baalo se chupayya chehra, Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2 Khud raghla jel khanayna Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar (ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Tu shehr-e-khuda ka beta mei khatoon-e-jina ki beti) x2 kyu bhul gayi ye dunya, haay kyu bhul gayi ye dunya, Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2 Khud raghla jel khanayna Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar (ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Mahol sharabi tha ghazi, kufe me gayi jab zainab) x2 aur aal-e-nabi be parda, haay aur aal-e-nabi be parda, Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2 Khud raghla jel khanayna Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar (ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Mei awno-muhammad ki lasho par royi nahi hu ghazi) x2 De unka muje tu pursa, haay de unka muje tu pursa, Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar
<<MINI>>
(ghazi passa kinarehna) x2 Khud raghla jel khanayna Zera ayliyam ghamkhwar (ghazi passa kinarehna) x2
